The image shows a leaf (likely mango) with dark black, sooty deposits scattered across the surface. The spots are irregular, powdery-looking black patches distributed over the green leaf surface. There is no sign of necrotic lesions, sunken spots (Anthracnose), dieback of shoot tips, or white powdery coating (Powdery Mildew). The black, soot-like coating is characteristic of fungal growth on honeydew secretions.
